query:
UPDATE products SET description = 'The one that started the conversation. Bold block print on heavyweight cotton that gets softer with every wash. People will ask. You won''t have to explain.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
220 GSM heavyweight jersey
Ribbed crew neck
Double-stitched hems
Pre-shrunk fabric

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out

Do not bleach
